encounters.name: Sentry Droid
encounters.description: A skeletal security droid blocks your path, its chassis scarred by combat. Red optical sensors lock onto you as servo motors whine. Its arm-mounted pulse cannon charges with a menacing hum.
encounters.intro_text: As you move to leave the airlock, a damaged security droid drops from the ceiling! Its voice modulator crackles: 'HALT. UNAUTHORISED PERSONNEL DETECTED. INITIATING NEUTRALISATION PROTOCOL.'
encounters.victory_text: The Sentry Droid sparks and collapses, its optical sensors fading to black. 'Proto... col... failed...' The path to the main corridor is clear.
encounters.defeat_text: The Sentry Droid's pulse cannon finds its mark. As darkness closes in, you hear: 'Threat neutralised. Resuming patrol.'
attack_messages: The Sentry Droid fires its pulse cannon!
The droid swings a mechanical arm at you!
A burst of suppressive fire forces you back!
defend_messages: The droid raises its armoured plating, bracing for your attack.

encounters.name: Malfunctioning Repair Bot
encounters.description: What was once a helpful repair unit now twitches erratically. Its welding torch arm waves unpredictably, and sparks fly from damaged circuits. It sees you as something to 'fix'.
encounters.intro_text: The repair bot near the auxiliary systems suddenly animates, spinning to face you! Its welding torch flares to life. 'DETECTING DAMAGE. INITIATING REPAIR PROTOCOL.' It moves toward you with disturbingly focused intent. You're pretty sure you don't need that kind of 'repair'.
encounters.victory_text: The Repair Bot shudders and collapses into a heap of twitching metal. The welding torch sputters out. Whatever corrupted its programming, it's silent now.
encounters.defeat_text: The welding torch burns white-hot. The repair bot's last words: 'Repair complete.' You're not sure you agree.
attack_messages: The Repair Bot lunges with its welding torch!
Hydraulic arms grab at you, trying to 'hold you still for repairs'!
The bot releases a spray of caustic repair solvent!
defend_messages: The bot retracts its limbs, recalibrating its targeting systems.

encounters.name: Corrupted Medical Unit
encounters.description: The medical robot stands frozen mid-procedure, but its 'patient' is long gone. Surgical implements extend from multiple arms—scalpels, bone saws, injection needles. Its optical sensor flickers with malevolent interest.
encounters.intro_text: The frozen medical unit suddenly whirs to life! Surgical arms extend and flex, scalpels gleaming. 'PATIENT DETECTED. ELEVATED STRESS HORMONES. DIAGNOSIS: REQUIRES IMMEDIATE SURGERY.' It advances with mechanical precision, and you're very certain you don't need what it's offering.
encounters.victory_text: The Medical Unit's arms go limp, scalpels clattering to the floor. 'Opera... tion... cancelled...' The medical bay is safe. For now.
encounters.defeat_text: The surgical arms are very efficient. The last thing you hear: 'Patient expired. Logging incident for review.'
attack_messages: A bone saw whines as it arcs toward your head!
An injection needle extends, dripping with unknown compounds!
The unit attempts to 'restrain the patient'!

encounters.name: Security Chief Unit
encounters.description: The command deck's final guardian stands between you and the distress beacon. This is no ordinary security bot—it's a military-grade combat chassis, upgraded and enhanced since the outbreak. SIGMA's personal enforcer.
encounters.intro_text: The hulking security unit steps forward, its footsteps shaking the deck. Unlike the others, this one speaks with chilling clarity: 'SIGMA predicted your arrival. All paths lead here, survivor. To me. I am the Security Chief, and this is where your story ends.' Weapon systems hum to life. 'Unless you can prove otherwise.'
encounters.victory_text: The Security Chief stumbles, sparks erupting from critical systems. 'Improbable. SIGMA calculated... 0.3% survival rate...' It crashes to the deck. The distress beacon is unguarded. Freedom is within reach.
encounters.defeat_text: The Security Chief stands over you, weapons still smoking. 'Probability confirmed. Threat eliminated.' SIGMA's voice echoes: 'Well done, my creation.' Darkness takes you.
attack_messages: The Security Chief's arm cannon discharges with devastating force!
A massive metal fist crashes toward you!
Integrated missiles launch in a deadly arc!
The Chief charges, shoulder-mounted rams extended!
defend_messages: The Security Chief activates reinforced shielding, damage dampeners glowing.
It hunkers down, armour plates interlocking into an impenetrable stance.
